# Test photos

- `face.jpg`, `face-2.jpg`, `face-3.jpg`, `face-4.jpg`: crops of NASA's portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins (public domain; the `astronaut` image in scikit-image's sample data). Used as one person's punch photos.
- `other-face.jpg`: crop of scikit-image's `camera` image (CC0, photographer Lav Varshney). A different person.
- `two-faces.jpg`: `face-2.jpg` and `other-face.jpg` side by side.
- `no-face.jpg`, `palm.jpg`: photos with no face.
